what: Diagnosed and fixed vertical-line rendering artifacts under Apply-before-SR + reduced DLSS-NR model resolution (fix/dlssnr-presr-reduced-res-aliasing). Four fix attempts before finding the real cause: attempts 1-3 (multi-tap smoothing of the resolve's gSource/gModel enlarge read -- two tap-spacing variants, then a real gModelWorkScale-vs-actual-bound-size bug fix) all produced zero visible change in-game, confirmed via a diagnostic log proving the code path was genuinely executing -- ruling out "not running" and pointing at a wrong mechanism, not just under-tuning. Actual root cause, found by reading NeutwoDecode/HybridDecode's own code comments: Replace reversible modes (gReversibleMode 2/4) deliberately skip the highlight guard Composed modes always apply, and the decode's inverse diverges near white -- ordinary small per-pixel model noise near a bright sky exploded into large unclamped swings. Fix: reapply the existing Highlight-guard/gMaxRatio clamp to Replace's result, confirmed removing the artifact on the user's own hardware (Dawnwalker). Along the way, found and fixed (then explicitly reverted at user's request to keep the shipped fix scoped to the guard alone) a related white-point/exposure bug: "Game exposure" white-point source silently fell back to a static paper-white for games supplying DLSS.Pre.Exposure without an ExposureTexture. Shipped as PR #12, 2 commits -- the fix, then 3 real bugs caught by this project's own code-review skill (a degenerate near-black decode the guard's multiplicative rescale couldn't pull back up, the guard running before detail injection could silently widen past it, a stale menu tooltip) -> release v0.1.3-dlssnr-replace-highlight-guard.
why: user-reported bug, diagnosed live in-game across the session via repeated A/B tests (debug views, slider tests, exposure log inspection) rather than guessed at; each of the four attempts was tested and its result (pass/fail) directly shaped the next step rather than being assumed
